### Select models by multiple attributes

Source: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/wiki/proposals/rfc_1_orchestration

This selector targets models within the 'snowplow' package that are also configured with 'materialized=incremental'.

```sql
'models[package=snowplow, materialized=incremental]'
```

--------------------------------

Source: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/wiki/proposals/rfc_1_orchestration
